notes: Coverage: the whole image was opened once for layout, then half a once and half b once in that order. Every text block, line, word ending, punctuation mark, and inline/display formula was compared against both C and H, including all their agreements. Only 24 tight crops at unresolved loci were then opened; no half or whole image was reopened. No OCR, text recognition, PDF layer, outside scan, other-reader material, external research, or delegation was used.

The whole-page layout consists of a typescript text page with author number 4 above, archive pencil 4 below-left, one principal displayed formula, two underlined headings, underlined words, and local typed/pen corrections. There are no diagrams, independent drawings, sideways notes, signatures, salutations, or external marginal prose. The curved pen lines by non canonique, développements, Deligne, the inserted tensor prefix and AUC G are ordinary insertion connectors, represented by inserted macros and inventoried with their additions.

The page continues a discussion of classification in the Picard sense and describes the symmetry of X tensor X as s(X) in pi_1(C). It states a canonical homomorphism from pi_0 to the 2-torsion subgroup of pi_1. The source statement is recorded; no proof of this homomorphism or its canonicity was attempted.

The classification paragraph says that a Picard category is determined up to non-canonical equivalence by the two commutative groups and s, and relates zero s to the underlined word stricte. It contains an empty handwritten reference placeholder. These assertions were transcribed rather than independently proved.

The Remarques paragraph discusses the 2-category of strict Picard categories in terms of a full subcategory of the derived category of (Ab), with homology concentrated in degrees 0 and 1. The actual corrections lower the complex dots and H indices. H’s note reverses or leaves open that direction and wrongly calls alors handwritten; the crop shows typewritten alors.

The same paragraph calls the resulting statement assez grossier, writes non unique with an exclamation mark, proposes a structure theory for non-necessarily strict Picard categories and (Gr)-categories, and says developments are still dans les limbes. It calls for study in the framework of champs and adds Deligne with an empty reference. These tentative words and the plural pronoun qu’ils were preserved without grammatical repair.

The heading’s live 3 is handwritten over an older uncertain 2. The new section asks the universal problem of sending C into an AUC tensor-category so that every member of S has invertible image, says a solution always exists, proposes the name de fractions, and writes S^{-1}C. The last line ends at foncteur naturel and continues beyond this page; nothing was supplied after it.

C-alert coverage outside explicit doubt entries: interpreted is visibly interprété with one final é, not interprétée; the pronoun is qu’ils; Soient is plural; the exclamation mark is inside the non unique parentheses; loc. cit. and cat. keep their stops; all parentheses in (Ab) and tensor expressions were checked; AUC order and raised -1 in S^{-1}C were retained. Those agreed, settled readings are in notation/coverage rather than manufactured no-change entries.

Two newly qualified places merit main-reader adjudication: the second old body under tout has a visible internal bar, so ce precedes co in the undertext alternatives; and the cancelled two-letter word after étendus has an acute-like stroke above its first letter. Neither judgment was based on the expected French or the mathematical argument.

The first K’s alphabet doubt is removed because a single stem is visible and the rightward excess follows cancellation ink. The underlying e under live 2 and the physical two dots over the e of exemple are also resolved. Other retained doubts record genuinely merged or obscured strokes, not a preference for one witness.

Hand attributions are conservative descriptive assignments: regular monospaced serif forms are treated as typewriter, pen mathematical signs and corrections as his hand for this page’s annotation layer, and the pencil archive numeral as another unnamed hand. No identification of that hand was independently established.

All changes without crop_ids were settled in the single required half-image reading. They still need the main reader’s own adjudication crop under the supplied brief. Source-position corrections and uncertainty changes are counted against a witness only when the reading/state actually differs; macro-name conversions alone are not counted.

No mathematical proof, independent re-proof, computation, or formal certificate was performed in this run. Visual verification of the formulas and recognition of the stated argument are not mathematical proof events; math_checks is therefore empty.

Timing: start_utc is the first clock timestamp obtained during packet reading, not a reconstructed wall-clock time for the earlier brief-reading tool call. The whole-image call falls within the bounded interval shown in viewed; half timestamps were obtained immediately after their displayed images.
